book.notes: Compiled originally by Archibald Newton Whitten (first edition 1925). This 1973 printing carries copyright lines reading "Copyright © 1973 by Harp Of Ages, Inc., in ‘Harp of Ages.’ All Rights Reserved" on numerous individual songs, indicating Harp Of Ages, Inc. as the rights holder for new material added by this printing. Pages 1-12 comprise the front matter and rudiments. From there the book is unpaginated: songs are identified by song number alone, beginning at Song 1, rather than by a printed page number.

internalNote: Built from Kevin's own per-song extraction CSV (Harp_of_Ages_1973_index.csv), 438 songs. Real per-song data (meter, time signature, key, first line, text/music/harmonization attribution, source citations, scripture references, verse counts, historical notes, copyright notices, catalog codes) transcribed directly from the CSV with no enrichment or invention added. No scholarlyRecord section (publication history, bibliography) exists yet - unlike ScH1855/SoH1854, no dedicated research pass has been done for this book. publicationStatus is "draft" for the same reason: real per-song data, but not yet reviewed as an assembled scholarly record. IMPORTANT, per Kevin's own correction (2026-09-07): the CSV's numbering column, and therefore every key in this file's songs object, is SONG NUMBER, not printed page number - pages 1-12 are unpaginated front matter/rudiments, Song 1 starts after that, and the book carries no printed page numbers at all from there on. My first pass here mislabeled this as a page-number scheme and mis-described the first correction below as a 'page number correction'; it's really a song-numbering one. The lettered/half-numbered identifiers (22A, 65½, 109a, 200-A) are this book's own irregular SONG-number insertions between two whole numbers, not this project's usual t/b split-page suffixes for a shared printed page, and are preserved exactly as given in the source CSV.
